reviews.review:
okay, let me walk you through my experience. judge for yourself if you want, but i don't like this game at all.
TLDR: basic features like sniper rifles and vehicles are locked behind DLC
-go to multiplayer
-try to join server
-can't join it
-why not?
-oh it has some kind of mod that i don't have
-okay then.jpg
-looks for another server
-why does every server have mods?
-finds a server i can join
-joins game
-spawn in base
-okay, where is the objectiv-
-....i found the objective. 
-it's 3km away. 
-tries walking, just to be sure. 
-5 minutes later: 2.9 km
-well that's neat.
-walks back to base to find vehicle
-no trucks
-no boats
-two helicopters
-tries to get in helicopter
-"This is premium content, you must purchase helicopter DLC to use it"
-other helicopter is the same
-well **** you too, game
-starts walking to objective
-map is large
-very large
-and empty
-spent almost 1 hour of my life walking across an empty island while my team flew over me in helicopters
-i reach the combat area and almost get killed by sniper
-manage to kill the sniper
-tries to take his rifle
-"this is premium content. purchase the marksman DLC to use it"
-fml.jpg
-exit building
-get blown up by grenade
-respawn at base, 3km from objective
-quit game

Just got it played 4 hours so far, love it,
Except from i need to turn setting all the way down to get constant 60 fps on gtx 1070 and i7 2600k.
Good game though 8/10.

136 hours: it's fun. buy apex if you wanna play multiplayer

update as of 765 hours: idk why i said this before but download mods if you want the game to be +1000% better. despite the game feeling outdated & extremely janky, it's still really fun. please buy this game if you want a good milsim experience.

mod recommendations (not in order):
1. RHS (modern factions/ equipment/ vehicles)
2. CUP (way more content than RHS, however less quality)
3. Unsung ('Nam)
4. Faces of War & IFA3 (two really good WWII mods. FoW has Americans, British & Commonwealth, Germans, & Japanese. IFA3 has Americans, British & Commonwealth, Germans, & Soviets)
5. There is Only War (A very janky warhammer mod, still pretty cool though)
6. ACE3 ((use the original) this mod adds way more realistic aspects, the medical & interaction system are completely overhauled adding to immersion)
7. Aftermath (a pretty cool Fallout:NV mod which even adds a New Vegas map)
8. JSRS & Blastcore (JSRS adds realistic sound effects. Blastcore adds realitic particle effects)
